class Solution:
    def removeAlmostEqualCharacters(self, word: str) -> int:
        n = len(word)
        operations = 0
        i = 0
        while i < n - 1:
            if word[i] == word[i+1] or \
               (ord(word[i]) + 1 == ord(word[i+1])) or \
               (ord(word[i]) - 1 == ord(word[i+1])):
                operations += 1
                i += 2  # Skip the next character as we've dealt with it
            else:
                i += 1
        return operations
